title: Wikipedia: Indemnity
summary: Describes an indemnity as one party's contractual obligation to compensate another for loss, usually paired with hold-harmless wording, and quotes clause examples in which a named party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other. Motivates LC01 (indemnity as a clause type), LC02 (which named party is bound), and LC03 (one-way drafting). Motivation for the questions, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Non-disclosure agreement
summary: Classifies confidentiality agreements as unilateral (one-way), bilateral (mutual), or multilateral, and lists typical contents: the definition of what is confidential, the exclusions from what must be kept confidential, and a duty to give the disclosing party prompt notice of compelled disclosure. Motivates LC01 (confidentiality as a clause type), LC03 (reciprocal versus one-sided), LC06 (a defined term and its uses), LC07 (notice elements), and LC08 (carve-outs from a rule). Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Termination for convenience
summary: Describes a termination for convenience clause as one that lets a party end a contract without establishing the other party's default, and notes standard forms that allow termination at any time by written notice. Motivates LC04 (what a term expression describes) and LC07 (whether a notice provision states its method and recipient). Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Document comparison
summary: Describes document comparison, also called redlining, as identifying changes between two versions of a document, with a section on its use in the legal industry and the convention of showing deletions and insertions in a marked-up comparison. Motivates LC05 (sorting the comments that accompany a redline by whether they seek a substantive or an editorial change). Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Exclusion clause
summary: Describes clauses that exclude or limit a party's liability and notes that courts read such clauses strictly and against the party relying on them. Motivates LC01 (limitation of liability as a clause type) and LC08 (whether a clause states exceptions to its own rule). How any such clause is enforced is a legal question that stays with the lawyer. Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.
